groups.sentence: Students do not submit their own work to AI tools for editing, revising, rewriting, proofreading, or checking.
Students do not use AI to fix bugs, rewrite proofs, or perform analytical tasks for them.
Students rely solely on their own abilities and skills when drafting, editing, and revising assignments.
Instructors tell students that AI editing tools such as Grammarly and AI revision or copyediting fall under the restrictions.
